title: 第39章 反常举动，班长吃错药了？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 连部，厕所里。高峰嘴上叼着烟，脚踏黄河两岸。手里拿着一部几乎被盘到包浆的步步高音乐手机，眼睛紧紧盯着屏幕。时间一到，他立马快速点击，将营长和教导员QQ农场里的菜全部偷的一干二净。完事，他又将自已那几辆二手奥拓，全部停到别人车位上。做完这些，他心里畅快极了，像是干了一件特别了不起大事。就在高峰嘿嘿嘿坏笑时，急促的脚步声传来。“老高，老高，别拉了，团里又来人了！”“什么？”高峰笑容唰的一下就没了。立马上演了一出;有内鬼，终止交易。强行中断施法后胡乱擦了擦，他急忙忙的就提上裤子，跟着何镇涛一块往外走。高峰扶了扶帽子，神色匆匆的问：“这次来的是团里哪位领导？”何镇涛回应：“还是副正委，不过这回没亲自过来，派了个干事过来，说是给咱们送点东西。”“送东西，送什么东西？”高峰脚步顿了顿，大脑开始快速思考。别是天冷了，给他们送温暖？何镇涛见状，拉着他就往门岗值班室走：“别想了，到了不就知道了？”二人三步并作两步，很快来到门口值班亭，却并没有瞧见那名团部干事的影子。负责值班的卫兵敬了个礼：“连长好，指导员好！”“人呢？”“一分钟前刚走，不过，说要我把东西交给你们。”瞧见卫兵搬上来一个泡菜坛子，二人对视一眼，满脸困惑。卫兵：“那人带了句话，说副政委牙口不好，吃不惯你们新兵连炊事班腌的咸菜，让你们自已尝尝看。还说，让你们自已看着办？”高峰狐疑的走上前，打开了泡菜坛上的盖子。指导员也立即凑上来，想看看到底怎么个事？当二人看到里头的电子产品后，顿时脸色铁青。他俩可算是明白，为什么昨天找炊事班谈话时，一帮人为什么支支吾吾遮遮掩掩。合着这帮家伙不声不响的捅娄子，都特么捅到团部去了！……“他奶奶的，你这司务长，到底还能干不能干了，啊？”食堂后厨，高峰手里抱着个泡菜坛子，冲着食堂这帮人大发雷霆。司务长，专门负责后勤工作，食堂也在他的管辖范围内。现在炊事班出了纰漏，第一个要问责的自然是他。司务长认错认罚：“连长，我已经狠狠的批评教育过他们了，这件事确实做的过分了。这是大家的检讨……”高峰一口怒气瞬间被怼在喉咙里。司务长是个典型的老油条，在部队里时间比高峰还要长。昨晚他去了趟团部，没能把东西要回来就知道肯定要出事。于是连夜就让所有人写好检查，以备不时之需。果不其然，暴风雨终究还是来了，这些检讨书，就是能够帮他们遮蔽风雨的小伞。高峰是个直脾气，不擅长和老油条打交道，但不代表何镇涛就这么容易被糊弄。“司务长，昨天我找你们谈话，为什么不交代不汇报？我看你这分明就是侥幸心理在作祟！”“呵呵，就这么几张破纸，这事儿就过去了，门儿都没有！”“中午做完饭所有人全副武装，操场二十圈，结束以后给我把后山那块荒地给刨了！”“不管是种萝卜，还是种白菜，养鸡还是养鸭，总之要看见成效，不然新训结束给你们全体记处分！”“另外，我要你们必须，立刻想办法解决战士们吃不饱，以及容易饿肚子的问题，拿不出解决办法我就解决你们！”“最后，检讨书重新写，每人两千字；司务长，三千字！”噼里啪啦的一连串的处罚下来，直接给所有人砸的昏头转向。原先，新兵连炊事班算个肥差，除了一日三餐以外，他们有大把空闲时间。可现在，哪里还有摸鱼的机会，闲下来就得去后山开荒，这尼玛也太惨了。司务长知道指导员没那么好说话，还想试着跟连长讨价还价：“连长，这罚的也太重了，能不能......？”高峰瞪着眼睛：“现在知道疼了，早干嘛去了？一袋子炒面搞得乱七八糟，满城风雨，这就是你们炊事班干的事儿！”众人齐刷刷瞥了一眼上等兵刘诚，心里把他祖宗十八代都骂臭了。刘诚心里也很委屈，明明主要是司务长的问题，怎么都怨我啊？但眼下，他们也只能是认罪认罚，因为大家都清楚。之所以罚的重，是因为团里领导在看着呢。要是罚的轻了，估计那位谭副正委，就得找连长和指导员的麻烦了。……“哟哟哟，快看，快看，忍者神龟哎！”“什么忍者神龟，这叫背黑锅！”中午的三公里跑，操场上多了一群显眼包。这帮人，背着锅，扛着米，提着油，哼哧哼哧跑的满脸痛苦。陆阳看着实在有点儿想笑，也大概猜到应该是和昨天那件事有关。尤其是哪个叫刘诚的上等兵最惨，别人是一包大米，他得提两包，谁让他昨天那么能咋呼？收回目光，陆阳回头寻找他那老乡的身影，却发现他掉到了最后头。位置处于三班和四班的夹缝中间，这是疏远的表现，说明他心里逐渐开始不认同这个班集体。就在这时，他看到周凯东有意无意的减速，似乎想要利用跑步的机会，和丁腾飞谈一谈。可周凯东刚靠近，对方就主动疏远，甚至于四班长还故意跑到前面来，挡在二人之间。从四班长那眼神不难看出，他还在对之前流动红旗的事情耿耿于怀。再加上这次丁是为集体犯错误，周凯东的处理却有失偏颇。这也导致他看周凯东更加不爽，即便他兼着一排排长，也根本不放在眼里。部队，有时候直来直去，有时候也会出现弯弯绕绕，和解不开的结。陆阳看着周凯东灰溜溜的模样，有心想帮却又爱莫能助。解铃还须系铃人，他俩之间的矛盾，只能他俩调和解决。给予能不能解决，陆阳就说不准了，弄不好他这个执拗的老乡会一直保持拧巴状态，直到下连。这时，孔垄从前头减速，凑到陆阳身边：“你有没有觉得，班长有些不对头？”陆阳诧异：“连你都看出来了？”孔垄嗯了一声：“上午训练，他一个脏字都没有，连我走路顺拐了都没骂我，你说是不是很反常？”陆阳苦笑，周凯东现在满心自责，哪还有心思去批评你，他批评自已都还来不及。孔垄言之凿凿：“所以，班长是不是……吃错药了？”“嗯？”“要不就是脑袋被门夹了，再要不就是被脏东西缠上了！”陆阳也是醉了，他又一次高估了这家伙的智商。孔垄言之凿凿：“跟你说，我们那儿有个出马，看这玩意儿可灵了。以前生病，我妈带我去看过，说我肩膀上有三个仙儿。”“地三鲜？”“什么呀，就是那种.....”陆阳打断他的迷惑性发言，这玩意儿再聊下去就不合适了：“孔垄，你说实话，你小时候吃啥奶粉长大的？”孔垄想了想：“好像是，三路？”陆阳点头：“嗯，那合理了。”“啥合理？”“垄啊，脑子要是不用，就捐了吧。”“这也能捐？我还以为只有心肝脾肺肾能捐呢？”“……”……第二天清晨，温度比平时低了很多。五点多的天没有丝毫要亮的迹象，风从门缝里吹着号子挤进来，发出毛骨悚然的呜咽声。陆阳从床上坐起，习惯性的在后背上挠两下。看了眼系统上的时间，发现竟比平时晚了五分钟？天太冷了，连他都有些睡过了头！他连忙起身将其他人叫醒，可得到的却是一肚子牢骚。“班副，让我们多睡会吧，我眼睛都睁不开。”“太冷了，让我再眯一会儿，就一会儿。”“班长不也还没起来吗，他起来我们就起来。”陆阳扭头看向靠在门口的床铺，发现周凯东缩在被子里，没有一点儿想起来的意思。“规定起床时间是六点，继续睡。”周凯东声音传来，所有人大喜过望。赶紧重新钻进被子，享受着被窝里的余温。没有人不爱睡懒觉，尤其是冬天的懒觉，陆阳也不例外。但部队里除了过周末，几乎是不可能让人睡到整点起来的，这也太反常了！严格来说，从昨天开始班长就很反常，像是变了个人似的，不再如之前那般严厉，反而变得“善解人意”起来。但陆阳知道这不是什么好事，兵熊熊一个，将熊熊一窝。班长不再严厉的后果就是，新兵集体偷懒，全班水平的严重下滑。陆阳没有回到床上，也没有做出什么越权的行动，只是默默地穿好衣服，蹲在地上整理起自已的内务。周凯东背对着里屋，他能够听到陆阳在整理内务的声音，却始终无动于衷。紧跟着，床板踩踏的声音传来，丁腾飞也从上铺下来，默默的抱着被子去了走廊。两个人一个在宿舍里，一个在宿舍外，各自整理自已的内务，谁也不吭声。时间很快来到六点，随着起床号响起，孔垄等人这才舒舒服服的从被窝里起来。尽管只是比平时多睡了半小时，但却比吃了肉还香。宿舍里位置太小，大家往常那般，各自找地方叠被子。外头的天阴沉沉的，还刮着风，看着一副要下雨的样子。果不其然，轰隆隆的雷声响起，豆大的雨点落下，地上很快就被打湿，就连空气都变得湿冷湿冷的。看着外头的雷雨天，每个新兵脸上都露出激动兴奋的表情。“班副，下雨了，是不是就可以不用出操了？”“听过一个成语，叫雷打不动吗？”“啥意思？”“下雨，又不是下刀子，死不了人。”那家伙终于开口说话了，但小嘴就跟淬了毒一样。陆阳探头朝着外头看了眼，觉得他其实可以继续闭嘴当哑巴，也挺好的。
content_en: Company headquarters, in the toilet.Gao Feng holds a cigarette in his mouth and steps on both sides of the Yellow River.In his hand, he held a BBK music cell phone that was almost wrapped to the pulp, and his eyes were fixed on the screen.When the time came, he immediately clicked quickly and stole all the vegetables from the camp commander and instructor QQ's farm.When he was done, he parked all his second-hand Altos in other people's parking spaces.After doing this, he felt very happy, as if he had done something special and great.Just when Gao Feng was grinning, the sound of rapid footsteps came."Old Gao, Lao Gao, stop it, there's someone in the group again!" "What?" Gao Feng's smile suddenly disappeared.A drama was immediately staged; there was an insider and the transaction was terminated.After forcibly interrupting the spellcasting and wiping it randomly, he hurriedly pulled up his pants and followed He Zhentao out.Gao Feng held up his hat and asked hurriedly: "Which leader of the regiment is here this time?" He Zhentao responded: "It's still the deputy committee member, but he didn't come in person this time. He sent a clerk over and said he would give us something." "Send something, what thing?" Gao Feng paused and his brain began to think quickly.Don't worry, it's cold. Why don't you bring them warmth?Seeing this, He Zhentao pulled him towards the duty room: "Don't think about it, we'll know when we get there?" The two of them took three steps at a time and quickly arrived at the duty booth at the door, but they didn't see the shadow of the regiment officer.The guard on duty saluted: "Hello, company commander, hello instructor!" "Where is the person?" "I just left a minute ago, but I asked me to hand over the things to you." Seeing the guard bringing up a pickle jar, the two looked at each other with confusion on their faces.Guard: "The man said something, saying that the deputy political commissar has bad teeth and can't get used to the pickles pickled by your recruit company's cooking class, so he asked you to try it yourself. And he also said, he said, let you decide what to do?" Gao Feng stepped forward suspiciously and opened the lid of the pickle jar.The instructor immediately came over and wanted to see what was going on?When the two of them saw the electronic products inside, their faces turned pale.They both understood why they were hesitant and secretive when talking to the cooking class yesterday.Together with these guys, they stabbed Lou Zi silently, and they even stabbed the regiment headquarters!..."Grandma, as the chief of staff, can you still do your job?" Gao Feng, the back cook in the cafeteria, held a pickle jar in his hand and was furious at the people in the cafeteria.The Chief of Staff is responsible for logistics work, and the canteen is also under his jurisdiction.Now that something went wrong in the cooking class, he was naturally the first to be held accountable.The chief of staff admitted his mistake and accepted his punishment: "Company commander, I have severely criticized and educated them. This matter has indeed gone too far. This is everyone's review..." Gao Feng's anger was instantly felt in his throat.The Chief of Staff is a typical veteran who has been in the army longer than the peak period.He went to the regiment headquarters last night and knew something was going to happen when he couldn't get his things back.So I asked everyone to write a check overnight to prepare for emergencies.Sure enough, the storm came after all, and these self-reflections were small umbrellas that could help shield them from the wind and rain.Gao Feng has a straight temper and is not good at dealing with old fritters, but that doesn't mean that He Zhentao is so easily fooled."Chief Secretary, I talked to you yesterday, why didn't you explain or report? I think you are obviously taking a chance!" "Haha, just a few scraps of paper, this matter is over, and there is no way!" "After lunch, everyone is fully armed, and they lap the playground twenty times. After that, they will dig up the wasteland in the back mountain for me!" "Whether it is planting radishes or cabbage, raising chickens or ducks,In short, you must see results, otherwise you will all be punished after the new training!" "In addition, I want you to immediately find a solution to the problem of soldiers not having enough to eat and being prone to hunger.If you can't come up with a solution, I will solve it for you!" "Finally, rewrite the review letter with two thousand words for each person;the chief of staff, three thousand words!" A series of crackling punishments immediately stunned everyone.It turns out that the recruit company's cooking team is considered a weak job. In addition to three meals a day, they have a lot of free time.But now, wherever there is an opportunity to fish, you have to go to the back mountains to open up wasteland in your free time. This is too miserable.The division commander knew that the instructor was not so easy to talk to, and wanted to try to bargain with the company commander: "Company commander, this punishment is too severe, can you...?" Gao Feng glared: "Now that I know it hurts, why did I go there earlier? A bag of fried noodles made a mess, and the whole city was full of trouble. This is what your cooking class did!" Everyone glanced at the first class soldier Liu Cheng, and in their hearts they scolded him for eighteen generations of his ancestors.Liu Cheng also felt aggrieved. It was obviously mainly the Secretary's fault, so why did he blame me?But for now, they can only plead guilty and accept punishment, because everyone knows it.The reason why the punishment is severe is because the leaders of the group are watching.If the punishment was light, Deputy Commissioner Tan would probably get into trouble with the company commander and instructor...."Hey, look, look, look, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!" "What Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles? This is called taking the blame!" During the three-kilometer run at noon, there was a group of conspicuous people on the playground.This group of people, carrying pots, rice, and oil, ran humming with pain on their faces.Lu Yang really wanted to laugh when he saw it, and he probably guessed that it had to do with what happened yesterday.Especially the superior soldier named Liu Cheng was in the worst situation. He had to carry two bags of rice while others had one bag of rice. Who made him so capable yesterday?Withdrawing his gaze, Lu Yang looked back to look for his fellow countryman, only to find that he had fallen to the end.His position was between Class 3 and Class 4, which was a sign of alienation and showed that he gradually began to disidentify from the class.At this moment, he saw Zhou Kaidong slowing down intentionally or unintentionally, as if he wanted to take advantage of the opportunity of running to talk to Ding Tengfei.But as soon as Zhou Kaidong got closer, the other party took the initiative to distance himself. Even the fourth squad leader deliberately ran to the front and stood between the two.It is not difficult to see from the look in the eyes of the fourth squad leader that he is still brooding about the red flag incident.In addition, this time Ding made a mistake for the collective, but Zhou Kaidong's handling was biased.This also made him feel even more unhappy with Zhou Kaidong. Even though he was also a platoon leader, he didn't take him seriously at all.The troops sometimes go straight, and sometimes there are twists and turns that cannot be untied.Lu Yang looked at Zhou Kaidong's dejected look and wanted to help but was unable to do so.To untie the bell, one must tie the bell. The conflict between them can only be resolved through reconciliation.Lu Yang couldn't tell whether giving could solve the problem. Otherwise, he, a stubborn fellow, would remain in a state of frustration until the next company.At this time, Kong Long slowed down from the front and approached Lu Yang: "Do you feel that something is wrong with the monitor?" Lu Yang was surprised: "Even you can see it?" Kong Long hummed: "In the morning training, he didn't use a single curse word, and he didn't even scold me for walking smoothly. Do you think it's abnormal?" Lu Yang smiled bitterly. Zhou Kaidong is so full of self-blame now that he has no time to criticize you. It's too late for him to criticize himself.Kong Long said firmly: "So, did the monitor... take the wrong medicine?" "Huh?" "Either his head was caught in the door, or he was caught in something dirty!" Lu Yang was also drunk, and he once again overestimated this guy's IQ.Kong Long said with certainty: "Let me tell you, we have a team over there who can see how effective this thing is. When I was sick before, my mother took me to see it and said there were three fairies on my shoulders." "Di San Xian?" "What, it's that..." Lu Yang interrupted his confusing speech. It was not appropriate to continue talking about this thing: "Kong Long, tell the truth."What kind of milk powder did you eat when you were a child?"Kong Long thought for a while: "It seems to be the third way?"Lu Yang nodded: "Well, what is reasonable?""Long, if you don't need it, just donate it.""I thought only the heart, liver, spleen, lungs and kidneys could be donated?""..." The next morning, the temperature was much lower than usual.It was past five o'clock and there was no sign of daylight. The wind blew in through the crack in the door, making a creepy whimpering sound.Lu Yang sat up from the bed and scratched his back twice out of habit.I looked at the time on the system and found that it was five minutes later than usual?It was so cold that even he overslept a little!He quickly got up and woke up the others, but all he got was complaints."Monitor, let's sleep a little longer. I can't even open my eyes." "It's too cold. Let me squint a little longer, just for a while." "The monitor hasn't gotten up yet. We'll get up when he gets up." Lu Yang turned to look at the bed against the door and found Zhou Kaidong huddled in the quilt, showing no intention of thinking about it."The stipulated time to wake up is six o'clock, keep sleeping." Zhou Kaidong's voice came, and everyone was overjoyed.He quickly got into the quilt again and enjoyed the remaining warmth in the quilt.Everyone doesn't like to sleep in, especially in winter, and Lu Yang is no exception.But in the army, except for weekends, it is almost impossible for people to sleep until the top of the hour. This is too abnormal!Strictly speaking, the squad leader has been acting strangely since yesterday, as if he has changed. He is no longer as strict as before, but has become "empathetic".But Lu Yang knew that this was not a good thing. One soldier was raging, and the generals were raging.The consequence of the squad leader no longer being strict is that the recruits are collectively lazy and the class level has seriously declined.Lu Yang did not go back to bed, nor did he do anything beyond his authority. He just got dressed silently and squatted on the ground to sort out his housework.Zhou Kaidong had his back to the back room. He could hear Lu Yang's voice cleaning up the house, but he remained indifferent.Immediately afterwards, the sound of stepping on the bed board came, and Ding Tengfei also got off the upper bunk, silently holding the quilt and going to the corridor.One of the two people was in the dormitory, the other was outside the dormitory, each was sorting out his own housekeeping, and neither of them said a word.The time soon came to six o'clock, and as the wake-up call sounded, Kong Long and others got up from the bed comfortably.Even though I only slept half an hour longer than usual, it tasted better than eating meat.The place in the dormitory is too small, so everyone has to find a place to fold their quilts as usual.The sky outside was overcast and windy, and it looked like it was going to rain.Sure enough, there was a rumble of thunder, huge raindrops fell, the ground quickly became wet, and even the air became clammy and clammy.Looking at the thunderstorm outside, every recruit had an excited expression on their face."Deputy deputy, since it's raining, does it mean we don't need to do the drills?" "Have you ever heard of the idiom, "Thunder can't move?" "What does it mean?" "It's raining, but it doesn't kill people if it's not a knife." The guy finally spoke, but his mouth was as if it had been quenched with poison.Lu Yang glanced outside and felt that he could actually continue to shut up and be mute, which would be fine.
